mika: quick check added a compact and expanded variant for pipeline create/delete in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique mika: question 1: label strategy on long vs compact forms — explicit '(required)' or asterisk + legend? question 2: deletion pacing instant delete vs trash+undo vs typed-confirm for flagged items? jamal: for long forms i prefer explicit '(required)' on labels for clarity. asterisk in lists or tables where space is tight. jamal: delete: trash+undo is great for most flows. typed-confirm only for flagged/sensitive resources or when downstream impact >1 job. sophie: accessibility note: whatever we pick, add aria-required, aria-invalid and make error summary programmatically focusable. screen reader users need a consistent announcement when summary appears. sophie: typed-confirm can be awkward for SR users if the name includes special chars. if we use typed confirm, provide a readable label and an example in the hint. ben: inline error tone: keep it short and imperative. e.g., 'Enter a name (3 60 chars)'. don't use full sentences inline. top summary can be slightly more verbose but link to fields. ben: also: don't rely on color. add icons or text. required should not be only color. aria: microcopy for undo snackbar: 'Moved to Trash Undo (30s)'. include role="status" and hidden text for screen readers: 'Pipeline moved to Trash. Undo available for 30 seconds.' aria: tiny code draft for aria-live + focus on summary: ```
2 problems found. Name, Schedule
// on link click: document.getElementById('name').focus(); ``` mika: love the snippet. final thought on hybrid delete rule: if resource.metadata.sensitive === true || selectedCount > 3 || downstreamJobs.length > 0 => show typed-confirm modal. else soft-trash. jamal: +1. and record these rules in the components doc so engineers can read the condition set. design-bot: checklist reminder: add 'voiceover walkthrough', 'keyboard-only undo', and 'error-summary focus' to PR checklist. :memo: mika: thanks all i'll update figma and ping for a rapid hallway test once updated. :thumbsup:
